one_liner: Cloud CRM platform for sales, service, and customer data management.

evidence.claim: Salesforce offers a documented public REST API for programmatic data access
evidence.quote: REST API provides you with programmatic access to your data in Salesforce.

evidence.claim: API authentication uses OAuth 2.0 via connected/external client apps
evidence.quote: For a connected app to request access, it must be integrated with the Salesforce API using the OAuth 2.0 protocol.

evidence.claim: Requests authenticate with an access token used as a bearer token
evidence.quote: Use the access token (also known as a “bearer token”) that you get from Salesforce CLI to authenticate cURL requests.

evidence.claim: Free Developer Edition org gives self-serve credentials for development
evidence.quote: Developer Edition provides a free and easy solution so that you can use Salesforce for testing and development.

evidence.claim: Salesforce provides official hosted MCP servers plus a GraphQL API
evidence.quote: Give AI agents a secure, governed way to interact with Salesforce data and automation using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

notes: Also offers GraphQL API (single endpoint, schema introspection), Connect REST API, and OAuth client-credentials flow for server-to-server via a dedicated Integration User. Official Hosted MCP Servers (SObject CRUD, Data 360, Tableau Next, custom Apex/Flow tools) exist but standard servers are disabled by default and must be enabled by an org administrator. Production API access requires a paid edition with API enabled (Enterprise/Unlimited/Performance); Developer Edition is free but capped. External client apps are replacing legacy connected apps.
